proposition: The dissertation gives two years for the completion of the Sharḥ Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam: the work entry (colophon) says 20 Ṣafar 814/13 June 1411, while the timeline says 813/1411; the entry's date is the one tied to a stated colophon, and the dissertation does not reconcile the two on these pages.
